originalMetadata.title: How Dopamine Ruins Your Mornings Before They Even Start
originalMetadata.description:
Every morning, before your day even begins, your brain is already hijacked. That first scroll, that first notification  it’s not harmless. It’s dopamine stealing your focus, motivation, and energy before you even leave your bed.In this video, we’ll uncover how your phone silently ruins your mornings and how you can take back control of your brain.

👉 Join my telegram for exclusive insights:
[ https://t.me/beyondbeing11 ]

1. How dopamine ruins your mornings before they even start.
2. Why your phone makes you lazy every morning.
3. The dark side of dopamine in the morning.
4. Stop checking your phone after waking up (here’s why)
5. How to fix your brain in the first 10 minutes of your day.

#DopamineDetox
#MorningMotivation
#FocusMindset
#selfimprovement 
#NoMoreDistractions
